theme_and_archetype.reasoning: A neuroimaging dashboard requires absolute precision, lack of distraction, and high contrast for medical imagery. Pure black backgrounds prevent glare and make volumetric renders pop.

functional.retinotopy_gradient: conic-gradient(from 0deg, red, yellow, green, cyan, blue, magenta, red)

layout_and_spacing.strategy: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID
layout_and_spacing.structure: Full-viewport height (100vh) application layout. No page scrolling, only panel scrolling.
layout_and_spacing.grid_configuration: flex h-screen w-full overflow-hidden bg-[#050505] text-[#F4F4F5]
layout_and_spacing.sidebar: w-80 or w-96 flex-shrink-0 border-r border-[#27272A] bg-[#111111] flex flex-col overflow-y-auto p-6 gap-6
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: dense (p-4 for panels, gap-4 for items)

buttons.primary: rounded-none bg-white text-black hover:bg-zinc-200 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold transition-colors w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: rounded-none bg-transparent border border-[#27272A] text-white hover:bg-[#1C1C1C] px-4 py-2 text-sm transition-colors w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.danger: rounded-none bg-[#FF3B30]/10 border border-[#FF3B30]/30 text-[#FF3B30] hover:bg-[#FF3B30]/20 transition-colors

components.sliders: Tailwind accent-white or shadcn/ui slider styled with sharp edges and white thumb/track.
components.toggles: Sharp, minimal visual footprint. Use standard shadcn switches but remove rounding if possible, or use a custom checkbox-like toggle.
components.color_wheel: A circular div (w-32 h-32 rounded-full mx-auto my-4 border-4 border-[#111111] shadow-[0_0_0_1px_#27272A]) using standard CSS `conic-gradient(from 0deg, red, yellow, green, cyan, blue, magenta, red)`. Add an inner dark circle to create a ring effect or keep as a solid disc.
components.file_upload: Styled as a dashed border dropzone area or a clean button. border-dashed border-[#27272A] hover:border-white transition-colors p-4 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2

visual_enhancers.surfaces: GRID BORDERS (The Technical Look). Expose the skeleton, 1px borders everywhere. No shadows. Absolute flatness.
visual_enhancers.motion: Minimal. Instant feedback on hover states (color shifts). No bouncy animations.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `@NeuroVue/NeuroVue` and use it within a React `useEffect` to attach to a standard HTML `<canvas>` element.
Configure NeuroVue to show a multi-planar view (axial, coronal, sagittal) + 3D view (using NeuroVue layout options).
The NeuroVue canvas wrapper must be flex-1 and take up 100% width and height of the right-hand panel.
Implement a 'Load MNI152' default state (use standard NIfTI URLs or NeuroVue's built-in fetchable volumes if available).
Create a sidebar component for 'Layer Management' on the left side.
For each overlay (Wang 2015, Benson 2014, Lesion Mask), create a cohesive control block. Each block should have: Layer Name, Visibility Toggle, and Opacity Slider.
The Lesion layer requires an HTML file upload input (accepting .nii.gz or .mgz). When loaded, it MUST overlay in red on the current view.
Implement a global 'Clip Plane' slider for the 3D view. NeuroVue exposes APIs for clipping planes (e.g., `nv.setClipPlane()`).
Include the Polar angle color disc visually in the sidebar when the Retinotopy layer is active, describing the color mapping.
Ensure all interactive elements have descriptive `data-testid` attributes (e.g., data-testid='upload-lesion-button', data-testid='opacity-slider-lesion').
Use Phosphor Icons or lucide-react for UI iconography (e.g., Eye/EyeClosed for visibility, Upload for file input).
Ensure the fonts (IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono) are imported via Google Fonts in the HTML or global CSS.
